purpose: Untouched external qualification of the Tampa quantitative early-warning hypothesis in the Texas Seagrass Monitoring Program before any raw seagrass data file is opened.

relationship_to_prior_external_attempts.caribbean_v1: terminal schema STOP with zero model fits and zero predictive scores
relationship_to_prior_external_attempts.alaska_v1: terminal header-transport STOP before response-body access
relationship_to_prior_external_attempts.alaska_v2: terminal endpoint-semantics STOP with response CSV unopened

source.authority: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information / University of Texas Marine Science Institute
source.stated_sampling: annual Tier-2 monitoring at fixed stations
source.stated_response_family: seagrass percent cover and related plant-condition measurements

record_only: file-list link names and href identities from the download index without following them

frozen_hypothesis.endpoint: Among source-year station-years with recorded focal seagrass presence, predict next-year recorded loss at the same stable station.
frozen_hypothesis.quantitative_augmentation: source-year species percent cover; if a second quantitative focal-state variable is officially defined before response access, it may be frozen as a secondary augmentation but not substituted post-outcome.

no_rescue: Do not open raw data files in Gate0.
Do not choose focal species from observed predictive performance.
Do not redefine recorded loss after response access.
Do not lower estimability minima after response access.
Do not select years or regions after inspecting outcome values.
